digest.component_or_area: opt-in verify.* gates (gate_enabled, plan-review close gate, completion close gate)
propositions: gate_enabled must raise ConfigError on an unreadable/malformed rebar.toml instead of catching it into GateState.UNREADABLE and silently proceeding
GateState.UNREADABLE is removed; GateState retains only ENABLED/DISABLED; ConfigError must be raised at the source so all gate consumers propagate the fault without re-implementation
rebar.claim and rebar.transition must fail loudly with ConfigError (chained from parse fault, naming gate label and ticket id) before any work or write lock when config is unreadable
CLI main() must catch ConfigError and render it as clean operator-facing failure (Error: <msg>, exit 1) instead of a traceback, matching the existing -c override error handling
close-path error must be raised pre-lock (BEFORE write lock acquired); no config read or gate work happens under the lock on the unreadable path
disabled gate skip verdict, gate_ran stamp semantics, and bool monkeypatch compatibility with tests must remain unchanged; readable config behavior is byte-identical
